title: Marston County Health Department
summary: A mid-size county health department (four health districts, three clinics, six POD sites, county-run IT and the state's surveillance and immunization systems) and a tabletop exercise generated from its simulated plans: a measles outbreak response while an intruder alters vaccination and case data in the department's systems.
notice: EXERCISE MATERIAL — for training use. Marston County, its health department, people, partners and identifiers are simulated; the public sources consulted for realism are listed in reference/county-public-health/SOURCES.md.

scenarios.title: Vaccine Vault Breach
scenarios.summary: In the second week of measles outbreak OB-2026-0147 in Health District 2, a script on the interface server MCHD-INT01 sends the state immunization registry 412 MMR doses nobody gave, false cases appear on the line list through the fax server, and the Saturday POD 2 appointments are cancelled from a phished account; the department must decide what to isolate, work on paper, keep the POD and answer a viral claim that children's records leaked.
